title: 第3章 发疯讨薪
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“还敢叫？再叫，可就不是这个价格了。”

苏玥玥立马闭嘴。

“别给我装，你们两的经济情况我比谁都清楚，十万块，还不至于拿不出来。”

谭筝双臂抱胸，欣赏二人纠结的神色。

见对方迟迟不回复，她索性点开手机，外放刚录制好的视频。

“啊——”

苏玥玥吓得失声尖叫，扑上来就要抢夺手机，却被谭筝一脚踹倒在地，好半晌没能起身。

看着身上的肌肉，谭筝满意地点了点头，看来平常没白锻炼，这力度和敏捷度，杠杠的！

江洲在一旁握紧了拳头。

若只是视频的话，他倒不怕，他主要是害怕吃回扣的事情被发现，他好不容易才爬到如今的位置上，绝对不能被开除。

“十万就十万！但是说好了，转完之后，马上将视频和证据删除！”

谭筝比了个OK的手势，表示没问题。

“立刻转账，备注自愿赠与。”

江洲率先操作手机，“叮——”的一声，提示音响起，谭筝看着收款信息露出了满意的笑容。

谭筝转头看向瘫在地上的苏玥玥：“你呢？想好了没？”

苏玥玥想到自己最近刚有起色的自媒体账号，一旦这件事被抖落出去，她在互联网上就只剩下负面的形象。

保不齐还要赛博永生。

想到这，苏玥玥只能咬牙说了声：“好。”

接连两笔款项进账，谭筝的账户余额已经上升到了一百四十万。

她也遵守约定，当场删除了视频。

“可不要想着动什么歪脑筋，敢惹我，我有的是法子整你们。”谭筝瞥见二人轻松不少的神色，不忘敲打一番。

钱到手，恶气也出了，谭筝起身离开。

“祝你们锁死哈！婚礼就不必喊我了，我不舍得随份子。”

房门闭合之际，屋内传来江洲和苏玥玥的争执声，好一阵鸡飞狗跳。

谭筝对此毫不在意，眼下抓紧时间搞钱才是最要紧的。

前脚刚离开江洲家，后脚工作搭子的电话就打进来了。

谭筝按下接听键：“喂，怎么了？今天我请假了，工作上有什么事情，你找王姐交接就行。”

“小筝！出事了！你快看工作群，老板在里头点名骂你呢！他叫你马上来公司，说你要是今天不来，以后也不用来了！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"You still dare to scream? If you scream again, it won't be at this price."

Su Yueyue shut up immediately.

"Don't pretend to me. I know your financial situation better than anyone else. One hundred thousand yuan is not enough to make you unable to pay."

Tan Zheng crossed her arms and admired the entangled expressions of the two.

Seeing that the other party didn't reply for a long time, she simply clicked on her phone and played the video she had just recorded.

"Ah——"

Su Yueyue was so frightened that she screamed and rushed forward to snatch the phone, but Tan Zheng kicked her to the ground and could not get up for a long time.

Looking at the muscles on his body, Tan Zheng nodded with satisfaction. It seemed that he did not exercise in vain. This strength and agility are amazing!

Jiang Zhou clenched his fists at the side.

If it was just a video, he wouldn't be afraid. He was mainly afraid of being found out about taking kickbacks. He had managed to climb to his current position with great difficulty, and he absolutely could not be fired.

"One hundred thousand is one hundred thousand! But we agreed that after the transfer is completed, the video and evidence will be deleted immediately!"

Tan Zheng made an OK gesture, indicating that there was no problem.

"Transfer the money immediately and make a note of the voluntary gift."

Jiang Zhou was the first to operate his mobile phone. With a "ding——" sound, the prompt sounded. Tan Zheng looked at the payment information and showed a satisfied smile.

Tan Zheng turned to look at Su Yueyue who was lying on the ground: "What about you? Have you thought about it?"

Su Yueyue thought about her own self-media account that had just gained momentum recently. Once this incident was revealed, she would only have a negative image on the Internet.

If the guarantee is not complete, cyber immortality will be required.

Thinking of this, Su Yueyue could only grit her teeth and say: "Okay."

With two consecutive payments, Tan Zheng's account balance has risen to 1.4 million.

She also kept her promise and deleted the video on the spot.

"Don't think of any crooked ideas and dare to mess with me. I have plenty of ways to deal with you." Tan Zheng caught a glimpse of the relaxed expressions of the two of them and did not forget to give them a beating.

With the money in hand and his anger out, Tan Zheng got up and left.

"I wish you all the best! You don't have to call me for the wedding. I don't want to follow the others."

When the door closed, the sound of Jiang Zhou and Su Yueyue's argument could be heard in the room, and there was a lot of excitement.

Tan Zheng didn't care about this. The most important thing now was to seize the time to make money.

As soon as the front foot left Jiangzhou's house, the call from the back foot's work partner came in.

Tan Zheng pressed the answer button: "Hey, what's wrong? I'm on leave today. If you have anything to do at work, just ask Sister Wang to take care of it."

"Xiaozheng! Something happened! Look at the work group, the boss is calling you names and scolding you! He told you to come to the company immediately, and said that if you don't come today, you won't come back in the future!"
